pure-announcement.rationale: It is the vendor's docs landing page rather than a launch, release note or funding announcement, though it is equally promotional in character.

duplicate.rationale: The nearest concepts (deprecation policy, OSV format, eval envelopes, SIEM gap) share no ground with an LLM observability platform overview.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The feature claims are trivially checkable against the Langfuse repository and the docs pages they link to.

durability.rationale: It is a vendor feature catalog — the exact genre the rubric names as aging poorly — whose content tracks the product's changelog rather than any mechanism or trade-off.

actionability.rationale: Beyond signalling that an open-source, OTel-based tracing/prompt/eval platform exists for stack selection, every bullet is a feature name plus a link with nothing a builder could apply.

atomicity.rationale: It is a catalog of four parallel feature areas (tracing, prompts, evals, platform) with no single extractable concept beneath the product name.
